en.t: Antioch suffers its second major earthquake in two years, killing thousands and destroying its remaining edifice
en.s: The 528 Antioch earthquake was the second major earthquake to affect the city in a span of two years. The shock occurring on 29 November, estimated at Ms 7.1, was viewed by its residents as the end of a series of disasters that had plagued Antioch. It killed at least 4,870 people and razed the remaining buildings that did not collapse in the earthquake of 526, and newly constructed ones.

zh.t: 安条克发生第二次大地震，数千人丧生，余下建筑被毁
zh.s: 528年安条克地震是该城两年内遭遇的第二次大地震。528年11月29日发生的地震估计震级为7.1级，当地居民将其视为一连串灾难的终结。至少有4870人遇难，526年地震后仍然屹立的建筑以及后来新建的建筑被夷为平地。

en.t: Following the death of King Chlothar I at Compiègne, his four sons, Charibert I, Guntram, Sigebert I and Chilperic I, divide the Frankish Kingdom
en.s: Chlothar I, sometime called "the Old" (French: le Vieux), (died c. December 561) also anglicised as Clotaire from the original French version, was a king of the Franks of the Merovingian dynasty and one of the four sons of Clovis I.

zh.t: 克洛泰尔一世去世后，四子瓜分法兰克王国
zh.s: 克洛泰尔一世有时被称为“老者”（法语：le Vieux），约于561年12月去世。他也被英语化称作克洛泰尔，是墨洛温王朝的法兰克国王，也是克洛维一世的四个儿子之一。

en.s: The Battle of Qianshuiyuan (Chinese: 淺水原之戰), northwest of present-day Changwu, Shaanxi, was fought in 618 between the Tang dynasty and the Qin state founded by Xue Rengao. The battle ended in victory for the Tang, whose armed forces were led by the future Tang emperor Li Shimin.

zh.s: 浅水原之战发生于618年，地点在今陕西省长武县西北，是唐朝与薛仁杲建立的秦国之间的一场战役。唐军在未来的唐太宗李世民率领下获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Qingkou (清口之戰) was fought in 897, during the period of constant warfare in China that preceded the collapse of the Tang dynasty. The battle was fought between armies loyal to the warlords Zhu Quanzhong (Zhu Wen) and Yang Xingmi, with Yang's army gaining victory.

zh.s: 清口之战发生于897年，当时中国正处于唐朝灭亡前的持续战乱时期。交战双方是朱全忠（朱温）和杨行密麾下的军队，杨行密一方获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Hama was fought some 24 km (15 mi) from the city of Hama in Syria on 29 November 903 between the forces of the Abbasid Caliphate and pro-Isma'ili Bedouin (called "Fatimids" or "Qarmatians"). The Abbasids were victorious, resulting in the capture and execution of the Isma'ili leadership. This removed the Isma'ili presence in northern Syria, and was followed by the suppression of another revolt in Iraq in 906.

zh.s: 903年11月29日，阿拔斯哈里发国军队与支持伊斯玛仪派的贝都因人在叙利亚哈马城外约24公里处交战。贝都因人被称为“法蒂玛派”或“卡尔马特派”。阿拔斯军获胜，俘虏并处决了伊斯玛仪派领导层，终结了伊斯玛仪派在叙利亚北部的活动。906年，伊拉克又发生一起起义，随后也被镇压。

en.s: The siege of Tyre took place from 29 November 1111 to 10 April 1112 when the coastal city of Tyre, in what is now Lebanon and was then in the hands of the Fatimid Caliphate, was besieged by the Crusader King Baldwin I of Jerusalem. In the previous years, Baldwin had taken the cities of Acre, Tripoli, Sidon and Beirut from the Fatimids.

zh.s: 1111年11月29日至1112年4月10日，耶路撒冷国王鲍德温一世率领十字军围攻沿海城市泰尔。当时泰尔位于今黎巴嫩境内，由法蒂玛哈里发国控制。此前几年，鲍德温已从法蒂玛王朝手中夺取阿卡、的黎波里、西顿和贝鲁特。

en.s: An earthquake occurred in the area of Marash during the early morning hours of November 29, 1114. It had an estimated surface-wave magnitude between 7.4 and 7.7 and an epicenter location in modern-day Turkey. The mainshock was preceded by two destructive foreshocks in August and November that same year. At least 40,000 people were killed in the earthquake; a number contested by historians due to the small population in the area at the time.

zh.s: 1114年11月29日清晨，马拉什地区发生地震，估计面波震级为7.4至7.7级，震中位于今土耳其境内。同年8月和11月的两次破坏性前震先于主震发生。地震至少造成4万人死亡；由于当时当地人口较少，历史学家对这一死亡人数存在争议。

en.s: The Battle of Krücken was a medieval battle fought in 1249 during the Prussian Crusades between the Teutonic Order and Prussians, one of the Baltic tribes. In terms of knights killed, it was the fourth largest defeat of the Teutonic Knights in the 13th century. Marshal Heinrich Botel gathered men from Kulm, Elbing, and Balga for an expeditionary attack deeper into Prussia.

zh.s: 克鲁肯之战是1249年普鲁士十字军东征期间条顿骑士团与普鲁士部族之间的一场中世纪战役。按阵亡骑士人数计算，这是条顿骑士团在13世纪遭遇的第四大败仗。元帅海因里希·博特尔从库尔姆、埃尔宾和巴尔加集结兵力，向普鲁士腹地发动远征。

en.s: The Battle of Manilla (1574) was a battle in the Manila area mainly in the location of what is now Parañaque between Chinese pirates, led by Limahong and the Spanish colonial forces and their native allies. The battle occurred on November 29, 1574 when Limahong's fleet landed in the town of Parañaque and from there, began to assault the fortifications of Intramuros. Initially, the inhabitants where disorganized and Limahong's forces routed them. Furthermore, the Chinese killed the Master-of-Camp of the Spanish, Martin De Goiti. This caused them to delay their assault on Manila as Martin de Goiti's house was an obstacle in their march.

zh.s: 1574年马尼拉之战发生在马尼拉一带，主要地点在今帕拉纳克市。双方为中国海盗林凤率领的部队，与西班牙殖民军及其当地盟友。1574年11月29日，林凤的舰队在帕拉纳克登陆，随后开始进攻王城的防御工事。起初，当地居民组织混乱，林凤的部队击溃了他们。中国士兵还杀死西班牙总指挥马丁·德·戈伊蒂；其住所挡住了他们行进路线，因此延误了对马尼拉的进攻。

en.s: The 1587 siege of Kraków took place between 14 October and 29 November 1587, after the contested 1587 Polish–Lithuanian royal election, which resulted in a double selection of opposing candidates - Zygmunt Waza was elected by the nobility on the 19th of August, while another faction of the gentry chose Maximilian III, Archduke of Austria, on the 22nd of August.

zh.s: 1587年10月14日至11月29日，克拉科夫遭到围攻，起因是波兰立陶宛王位选举出现争议。1587年8月19日，贵族选出齐格蒙特·瓦萨；8月22日，另一派贵族选出奥地利大公马克西米利安三世。

en.s: also known as Battle of Suvali, The naval Battle of Swally took place on 29–30 November 1612 off the coast of Suvali (anglicised to Swally) a village near the Surat, city of Gujarat, India, and was a victory for four English East India Company galleons over four Portuguese naus and 26 barks (rowing vessels with no armament).

zh.s: 斯瓦利海战又称苏瓦利海战，于1612年11月29日至30日在印度古吉拉特邦苏拉特附近的苏瓦利村外海发生。英国东印度公司的4艘大型帆船击败了葡萄牙的4艘纳乌帆船和26艘无武装桨船。

en.s: The 1614 battle of the Kizugawa(木津川の戦い) was one of a number of battles surrounding the siege of Osaka, in which the Tokugawa shogunate destroyed the Toyotomi clan, the last major opposition to its control of Japan. A fortress loyal to the Toyotomi controlled a section of the Kizu River (Kizugawa) near Osaka. After a shogunal reconnaissance mission, a pair of amphibious assaults were launched to seize it.

zh.s: 1614年木津川之战是围绕大阪围城战发生的一系列战斗之一。德川幕府试图摧毁丰臣家族，消除其对幕府统治的主要威胁。丰臣方的一座堡垒控制着大阪附近一段木津川。幕府军侦察后，发动了两栖进攻，试图夺取这座堡垒。

en.s: The Natchez revolt, or the Natchez Massacre, was an attack by the Natchez people on French colonists near present-day Natchez, Mississippi, on November 29, 1729. The Natchez and French had lived alongside each other in the Louisiana colony for more than a decade prior to the incident, mostly conducting peaceful trade and occasionally intermarrying. After a period of deteriorating relations, however, Natchez leaders were provoked to revolt when the French colonial commandant, Sieur de Chépart, demanded land from a Natchez village for his own plantation near Fort Rosalie.

zh.s: 纳奇兹起义又称纳奇兹大屠杀，是1729年11月29日纳奇兹人在今美国密西西比州纳奇兹附近袭击法国殖民者的事件。此前十多年，纳奇兹人与法国人在路易斯安那殖民地和平共处，主要从事贸易，偶尔通婚。后来双方关系恶化，法国殖民指挥官谢帕尔骑士要求纳奇兹村庄交出土地，供他在罗萨利堡附近开辟种植园，引发纳奇兹领袖起义。

en.s: The 1732 Irpinia earthquake was a seismic event with a magnitude of 6.6 that affected Irpinia and part of Sannio. It occurred on 29 November 1732 at 8:40 a.m. local time (UTC+1). The epicenter was located in the Campanian Apennines, in the area of the Ufita Valley, which is part of the modern-day Province of Avellino. Around twenty populated areas were destroyed entirely or in part and tens of others were significantly damaged.

zh.s: 1732年11月29日上午8时40分（UTC+1），发生6.6级地震，影响伊尔皮尼亚和桑尼奥部分地区。震中位于坎帕尼亚亚平宁山脉的乌菲塔山谷一带，即今阿韦利诺省境内。约20个有人居住的地区全部或部分被毁，另有数十个地区遭到严重破坏。

en.s: The Battle of Fort Cumberland (also known as the Eddy Rebellion) was an attempt by a small number of militia commanded by Jonathan Eddy to bring the American Revolutionary War to Nova Scotia in late 1776. With minimal logistical support from Massachusetts and four to five hundred volunteer militia and Natives, Eddy attempted to besiege and storm Fort Cumberland in central Nova Scotia (near the present-day border between Nova Scotia and New Brunswick) in November 1776.

en.t: San Jose, California, is founded as Pueblo de San José de Guadalupe by José Joaquín Moraga. It is the first civilian settlement, or pueblo, in Alta California
en.s: San Jose, officially the City of San José ( SAN hoh-ZAY, -⁠SAY; Spanish: [saŋ xoˈse]), is the most populous city in the San Francisco Bay Area and Northern California, and the 13th-most populous in the United States, with an estimated 989,814 residents as of 2025. The city's metropolitan area is home to nearly two million people, while the broader combined statistical area (the fifth-largest in the United States) has a population of over nine million.

zh.t: 圣何塞建城，成为上加利福尼亚首个民用聚居点
zh.s: 圣何塞（正式名称为圣何塞市；读作 SAN hoh-ZAY，-SAY；西班牙语： [saŋ xoˈse]）是旧金山湾区和北加利福尼亚人口最多的城市，也是美国人口第13多的城市。按2025年估算，居民有989,814人。其都会区人口近两百万；更大的联合统计区人口超过九百万，是美国第五大联合统计区。

en.t: Battle of San Fernando de Omoa
en.s: The Battle of San Fernando de Omoa was a short siege and battle between British and Spanish forces fought not long after Spain entered the American Revolutionary War on the American side. On the 16 October 1779, following a brief attempt at siege, a force of 150 British soldiers and seamen assaulted and captured the fortifications at San Fernando de Omoa in the Captaincy General of Guatemala (now Honduras) on the Gulf of Honduras.

zh.t: 圣费尔南多-德奥莫阿战役
zh.s: 这场短暂的围城战发生在英国与西班牙军队之间，时间距西班牙加入美国一方参加美国独立战争不久。1779年10月16日，英军曾短暂尝试围城，随后150名士兵和水手攻占了圣费尔南多-德奥莫阿的防御工事。该地当时属于危地马拉都督辖区（今洪都拉斯），位于洪都拉斯湾沿岸。

en.s: The Zong massacre was a mass killing of more than 130 enslaved African people by the crew of the British slave ship Zong over several days from 29 November 1781. The William Gregson slave-trading syndicate, based in Liverpool, owned the ship as part of the Atlantic slave trade. As was common business practice, they had taken out insurance on the lives of the enslaved Africans as cargo.

zh.s: 1781年11月29日起数日内，英国奴隶船“宗”号船员杀害了130多名被奴役的非洲人。这艘船属于利物浦的威廉·格雷格森奴隶贸易集团，参与跨大西洋奴隶贸易。按照当时常见的商业做法，船主为这些被当作货物的非洲人的生命投保。

en.s: On November 29, 1783, at 10:50 p.m. (UTC−5), a Mfa 5.3 earthquake occurred in the U.S. state of New Jersey. It was the state's first recorded seismic event. It is estimated that the quake was the largest and strongest that the state has ever recorded. The earthquake caused intensity VII damage on the Mercalli intensity scale.

zh.s: 1783年11月29日晚上10时50分（UTC−5），美国新泽西州发生地震，面波震级估计为5.3级。这是该州有记录以来的首次地震，也是该州有记录以来最大、最强的一次。地震造成麦加利地震烈度VII级的破坏。

en.t: John VI of Portugal flees Lisbon from advancing Napoleonic forces during the Peninsular War, transferring the Portuguese court to Brazil
en.s: Dom John VI (Portuguese: João Maria José Francisco Xavier de Paula Luís António Domingos Rafael; 13 May 1767 – 10 March 1826), known as "the Clement" (o Clemente), was King of the United Kingdom of Portugal, Brazil and the Algarves from 1816 to 1825, and after the recognition of Brazil's independence, titular Emperor of Brazil and King of Portugal until his death in 1826.

zh.t: 葡萄牙若昂六世为躲避拿破仑军队逃离里斯本，将宫廷迁往巴西
zh.s: 若昂六世（葡萄牙语：João Maria José Francisco Xavier de Paula Luís António Domingos Rafael；1767年5月13日—1826年3月10日），称号为“宽厚者”（o Clemente），1816年至1825年间担任葡萄牙、巴西和阿尔加维联合王国国王。巴西独立获承认后，他成为名义上的巴西皇帝和葡萄牙国王，直至1826年去世。

en.s: The action of 29 November 1811 was a minor naval engagement fought between two frigate squadrons in the Adriatic Sea during the Adriatic campaign of the Napoleonic Wars. The action was one of a series of operations conducted by the Royal Navy and the French Imperial Navy to contest dominance over the Adriatic between 1807 and 1814.

Napoleon was retreating toward Poland in chaos after the aborted occupation of Moscow and trying to cross the Berezina River at Borisov.

en.s: The Battle of Autossee took place on November 29, 1813, during the Creek War, at the Creek towns of Autossee and Tallassee near present-day Shorter, Alabama. General John Floyd, with 900 to 950 militiamen and 450 allied Creek, attacked and burned down both villages, killing 200 Red Sticks in the process.

en.s: The 1814 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 29, 1814, in order to elect the Governor of North Carolina. Democratic-Republican candidate and former Attorney General of North Carolina William Miller was elected by the North Carolina General Assembly against Federalist candidate and former member of North Carolina Council of State William Polk and Democratic-Republican candidate and former member of the North Carolina Senate George Outlaw.

zh.s: 1814年11月29日，北卡罗来纳州举行州长选举。民主共和党候选人、前州总检察长威廉·米勒由州议会选出，击败了联邦党候选人、前州委员会成员威廉·波尔克，以及民主共和党候选人、前州参议员乔治·奥特劳。

en.s: The Argentine raid on Monterey also known as the Argentine occupation of California was a military action carried out between November 24 and November 29, 1818, by naval forces from the United Provinces of the Rio de la Plata (modern-day Argentina) under the command of privateer Hipólito Bouchard. This operation was part of Bouchard's broader Pacific naval campaign during the Argentine War of Independence, aiming to disrupt Spanish colonial control along the Pacific coast of the Americas.

zh.s: 1818年11月24日至29日，普拉塔河联合省（今阿根廷）的海军部队在私掠船船长伊波利托·布沙尔指挥下，对蒙特雷发动军事行动，又称阿根廷占领加利福尼亚。这是布沙尔更广泛的太平洋海军行动的一部分，目的是削弱美洲太平洋沿岸的西班牙殖民统治。

en.s: The November Uprising (1830–31), Polish–Russian War 1830–31, also known as the Cadet Revolution, was an armed rebellion in the heartland of partitioned Poland against the Russian Empire. The uprising began on 29 November 1830 in Warsaw when the young Polish officers from the local Army of the Congress Poland's military academy revolted, led by lieutenant Piotr Wysocki. They were soon joined by large segments of societies of Lithuania, Belarus, and the right-bank of Ukraine. Despite local successes, the uprising was eventually crushed by a numerically superior Imperial Russian Army under Ivan Paskevich.

zh.s: 十一月起义（1830—1831年）又称1830—1831年波俄战争或学员革命，是波兰被瓜分后的核心地区反抗俄罗斯帝国的武装起义。1830年11月29日，华沙军事学院的年轻波兰军官在彼得·维索茨基中尉带领下发动起义。立陶宛、白俄罗斯和乌克兰右岸的许多人随后加入。尽管起义初期取得一些局部胜利，最终仍被伊万·帕斯凯维奇率领、兵力占优的俄罗斯帝国军队镇压。

Ibrahim Pasha's Ottoman Egyptian troops successfully besieged and stormed the troops of Abdullah Pasha.

en.s: The Whitman massacre (also known as the Whitman killings and the Tragedy at Waiilatpu) was the killing of American missionaries Marcus and Narcissa Whitman, along with eleven others, on November 29, 1847. They were killed by a small group of Cayuse men who suspected that Whitman had poisoned the 200 Cayuse in his medical care during an outbreak of measles that included the Whitman household.

zh.s: 1847年11月29日，一小群凯尤斯族人杀害了美国传教士马库斯·惠特曼、纳西莎·惠特曼及另外11人。这起事件又称惠特曼杀戮或怀拉特普悲剧。此前麻疹疫情蔓延至惠特曼家中，凯尤斯族人怀疑惠特曼在照料病人期间毒害了200名凯尤斯族人。

It ensued after seven Catholic cantons formed the Sonderbund ("separate alliance") in 1845 to protect their interests against a centralization of power. The war concluded with the defeat of the Sonderbund.

en.s: The Punctation of Olmütz (German: Olmützer Punktation), also called the Agreement of Olmütz, was a treaty between Prussia and Austria, dated 29 November 1850, by which Prussia abandoned the Erfurt Union and accepted the revival of the German Confederation under Austrian leadership. The treaty concluded the Autumn Crisis of 1850 in Germany. The treaty was the result of a conference held in Olmütz in the Austrian Margraviate of Moravia (now Olomouc, Czech Republic).

zh.s: 1850年11月29日，普鲁士和奥地利签署《奥尔米茨协定》，普鲁士放弃埃尔福特联盟，并接受在奥地利领导下恢复德意志邦联。该条约结束了1850年德国秋季危机。条约源于在奥地利摩拉维亚侯国奥尔米茨（今捷克奥洛穆茨）举行的一次会议。

James Longstreet failed to break through the defensive lines of Union Maj. Gen. Ambrose Burnside, resulting in lopsided casualties, and the Siege of Knoxville entered its final days.

zh.s: 桑德斯堡之战是美国内战诺克斯维尔战役的关键战斗，于1863年11月29日在田纳西州诺克斯维尔打响。詹姆斯·朗斯特里特中将率领邦联军进攻，但未能突破安布罗斯·伯恩赛德少将率领的联邦军防线，伤亡悬殊。诺克斯维尔围城战也进入最后阶段。

en.s: The Battle of Spring Hill was fought November 29, 1864, at Spring Hill, Tennessee, as part of the Franklin-Nashville Campaign of the American Civil War. The Confederate Army of Tennessee, commanded by Lt. Gen. John Bell Hood, attacked a Union force under Maj. Gen. John M. Schofield as it retreated from Columbia through Spring Hill. Because of a series of command failures, the Confederates were unable to inflict serious damage on the Federals and could not prevent their safe passage north to Franklin during the night. The next day, Hood pursued Schofield and attacked his fortifications in the Battle of Franklin, resulting in severe Confederate casualties.

zh.s: 1864年11月29日，美国内战期间，田纳西州斯普林希尔发生斯普林希尔之战，属于富兰克林—纳什维尔战役的一部分。约翰·贝尔·胡德中将率领田纳西邦联军，袭击约翰·M·斯科菲尔德少将率领的联邦军；后者正从哥伦比亚经斯普林希尔撤退。由于一连串指挥失误，邦联军未能给联邦军造成重大损失，也未能阻止他们连夜安全北撤至富兰克林。次日，胡德追击斯科菲尔德并进攻其防线，爆发富兰克林之战，邦联军伤亡惨重。

en.s: The Sand Creek massacre (also known as the Chivington massacre, the Battle of Sand Creek or the massacre of Cheyenne Indians) was a massacre in the American Indian Wars that occurred on November 29, 1864, when a 675-man force of Colorado U.S. Volunteer Cavalry attacked and destroyed a village of Cheyenne and Arapaho in southeastern Colorado Territory, killing and mutilating an estimated 70–163 Native Americans, about two-thirds of whom were women and children. The location has been designated the Sand Creek Massacre National Historic Site and is administered by the National Park Service.

zh.s: 桑德克里克大屠杀又称奇温顿大屠杀、桑德克里克之战或夏延人屠杀，是美国印第安战争期间的一起屠杀事件。1864年11月29日，675名科罗拉多美国志愿骑兵袭击并摧毁了科罗拉多领地东南部的一个夏延人和阿拉帕霍人村落，估计有70至163名原住民遇害，其中约三分之二是妇女和儿童。该地点现被列为桑德克里克大屠杀国家历史遗址，由美国国家公园管理局管理。

en.s: The Battle of Lost River in November 1872 was the first battle in the Modoc War in the northwestern United States. The skirmish, which was fought near the Lost River along the California–Oregon border, was the result of an attempt by the U.S. 1st Cavalry Regiment of the United States Army to force a band of the Modoc tribe to relocate back to the Klamath Reservation, which they had left in objection of its conditions.

en.s: The Constitution of the Empire of Japan (Kyūjitai: 大日本帝國憲法 Shinjitai: 大日本帝国憲法 Dai-Nippon Teikoku Kenpō), known informally as the Meiji Constitution (明治憲法 Meiji Kenpō) was the constitution of the Empire of Japan in force from November 29, 1890 until May 2, 1947. Enacted after the Meiji Restoration in 1868, it provided for a form of mixed constitutional and absolute monarchy, based jointly on the Prussian and British models. In theory, the Emperor of Japan was the supreme ruler, and the Cabinet, whose Prime Minister would be elected by a Privy Council, were his followers; in practice, the Emperor was head of state but the Prime Minister was the actual head of government.

zh.s: 《大日本帝国宪法》非正式名称为《明治宪法》，是日本帝国的宪法，于1890年11月29日至1947年5月2日生效。该宪法在1868年明治维新后制定，结合了普鲁士和英国模式，建立了兼有立宪与绝对君主制特征的政体。理论上，日本天皇是最高统治者，内阁成员由枢密院选出并辅佐天皇；实际上，天皇是国家元首，首相才是政府首脑。

en.t: FC Barcelona is founded at the Solé Gymnasium

en.t: Battle of San Francisco de Macoris
en.s: The Battle of San Francisco de Macoris took place on 29 November 1916 during the early stages of the United States occupation of the Dominican Republic. Dominican forces in San Francisco de Macoris had refused to lay down their arms and had taken control of the local fortaleza. This was in direct violation of the terms imposed by the military government installed by the United States. A small squad of Marines that were close by were able to make their way inside the fortaleza and surprise the defenders, securing it before any organized resistance could take place.

zh.t: 圣弗朗西斯科-德马科里斯之战
zh.s: 1916年11月29日，美国占领多米尼加共和国初期，圣弗朗西斯科-德马科里斯发生战斗。当地多米尼加部队拒绝放下武器，并控制了当地要塞，违反了美国设立的军事政府所规定的条件。一小队附近的美国海军陆战队设法潜入要塞，在守军尚未组织抵抗前发动突袭并夺取要塞。

en.t: Siberian White Army forces begin an offensive toward Perm
en.s: On November 29, 1918, Siberian White Army units in the Yekaterinburg group began advancing toward Perm during the Russian Civil War. The operation was directed against the Red Army's eastern front and continued for weeks. White forces took Perm in late December; the fighting and later Red Army counteroffensive extended into January 1919. November 29 marks the opening of the offensive, not the capture of the city.
en.n: The offensive began November 29; White forces captured Perm only in late December.

zh.t: 西伯利亚白军向彼尔姆发起攻势
zh.s: 1918年11月29日，俄国内战期间，西伯利亚白军叶卡捷琳堡集群开始向彼尔姆方向进攻，目标是红军东部战线。这场作战持续了数周。白军到12月下旬才占领彼尔姆，之后红军又发起反攻，战事延续至1919年1月。因此，11月29日是攻势开始的日子，并非彼尔姆失守之日。
zh.n: 进攻于11月29日开始；白军直到12月下旬才占领彼尔姆。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Estonia between 27 and 29 November 1920, the first held under the 1920 constitution. 100 deputies were elected into the new Riigikogu by party lists in 10 regions, by which one party or electoral bloc could put up several lists in one region. Seats were still distributed on the state level, where votes for different lists were summed up by their political affiliation and then seats distributed using d'Hondt formula. Thereafter seats for one party or bloc were distributed between different lists of that political force using the same formula.

zh.s: 爱沙尼亚于1920年11月27日至29日举行议会选举，这是根据1920年宪法举行的首次选举。100名议员由10个地区的政党名单选出，一个政党或选举联盟可在同一地区提出多个名单。席位仍在全国范围内分配：先汇总不同名单的政党票，再按汉狄法分配席位；随后再将各政党或联盟的席位按同一方法分配给其不同名单。

en.t: Richard Byrd's crew reaches the South Pole vicinity by air
en.s: On November 29, 1929, an aircraft carrying explorer Richard E. Byrd and three crewmates reached the vicinity of the South Pole during a flight from the Little America base in Antarctica. Byrd navigated, Bernt Balchen piloted, Harold June handled radio, and Ashley McKinley took photographs. Their archived flight log records Byrd's calculation that they had reached the pole's vicinity; a later review concluded their course passed within four nautical miles of it.
en.n: November 29 is the date of the recorded approach to the pole; the flight spanned November 28–29. The archival review establishes a route within four nautical miles, not an exact surveyed crossing of the geographic point.

zh.t: 伯德一行驾机抵达南极点附近
zh.s: 1929年11月29日，探险家理查德·伯德与三名同伴在从南极洲小美洲基地出发的飞行中，抵达南极点附近。伯德负责导航，伯恩特·巴尔琴驾驶飞机，哈罗德·朱恩负责无线电，阿什利·麦金利负责摄影。留存的飞行日志记下了伯德对位置的判断；后来的路线复核认为，他们的航线距南极点不到4海里。
zh.n: 11月29日是日志记载飞机抵达南极点附近的日期；航程跨越11月28日至29日。档案只能证实航线进入南极点4海里范围，不能据此断言飞机精确飞越地理南极点。

en.s: Operation Uzice was the first major counter-insurgency operation by the German Wehrmacht on the occupied territory of the Kingdom of Yugoslavia during World War II. The operation was directed against the Užice Republic, the first of several "free territories" liberated by the Yugoslav Partisans. It was named after the town of Užice, and is associated with the First Enemy Offensive (Serbo-Croatian Latin: Prva neprijateljska ofenziva/ofanziva) in Yugoslavian historiography.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 第二次世界大战期间，德国国防军在被占领的南斯拉夫王国境内展开了首次大规模反叛乱行动，目标是乌日策共和国——南斯拉夫游击队解放的数个“自由地区”中的第一个。行动以乌日策镇命名；在南斯拉夫史学中，它与“第一次敌方攻势”（塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语拉丁文：Prva neprijateljska ofenziva/ofanziva）相关联。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Uprising in Serbia was initiated in July 1941 by the Communist Party of Yugoslavia against the German occupation forces and their Serbian quisling auxiliaries in the Territory of the Military Commander in Serbia. At first the Yugoslav Partisans mounted diversions and sabotage and attacked representatives of Milan Aćimović's quisling administration. In late August some Chetniks joined the uprising and liberated Loznica.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 1941年7月，南斯拉夫共产党在塞尔维亚军事指挥官辖区内发动起义，反抗德国占领军及其扶植的塞尔维亚辅助力量。起初，南斯拉夫游击队进行破坏和突袭，并袭击米兰·阿奇莫维奇傀儡政府的官员。8月下旬，部分切特尼克加入起义，并解放了洛兹尼察。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: General elections were held in Uruguay on 29 November 1942, alongside a constitutional referendum. The result was a victory for the Colorado Party, which won a majority of seats in the Chamber of Deputies and received the most votes in the presidential election, in which the Juan José de Amézaga faction emerged as the largest. Amézaga subsequently became President on 1 March 1943.

zh.s: 1942年11月29日，乌拉圭举行大选，同时就宪法修正案进行公投。红党获胜，在众议院赢得多数席位，并在总统选举中获得最多选票；其中胡安·何塞·德·阿梅萨加派系得票最多。阿梅萨加随后于1943年3月1日就任总统。

en.t: AVNOJ's second session meets in Jajce
en.s: On November 29, 1943, the Anti-Fascist Council for the National Liberation of Yugoslavia (AVNOJ) met for its second session in Jajce, in what is now Bosnia and Herzegovina. Ivan Ribar presided over the gathering, which continued on November 30. Its decisions laid out a federal framework for a postwar Yugoslavia and created a provisional executive body. The meeting took place during the Second World War, while Yugoslav partisans were fighting Axis occupation.
en.n: The second session ran November 29–30; November 29 was not its conclusion date.

zh.t: 南斯拉夫反法西斯人民解放委员会在亚伊采举行第二次会议
zh.s: 1943年11月29日，南斯拉夫反法西斯人民解放委员会在今天的波斯尼亚和黑塞哥维那亚伊采举行第二次会议，由伊万·里巴尔主持。会议持续到11月30日，通过的决议为战后的联邦制南斯拉夫拟定了框架，并设立临时执行机构。当时正值第二次世界大战，南斯拉夫游击队仍在抵抗轴心国占领。
zh.n: 第二次会议从11月29日开到30日，并非在29日结束。

en.s: The Battle of Batina or Batina Operation (Serbo-Croatian: Bitka kod Batine) was fought on the Syrmian Front of the Second World War between the units of the Red Army and the Yugoslav Partisans against the Wehrmacht and their allies. The battle took place from 11 to 29 November 1944 near the village of Batina in Baranja, on the right bank of the Danube River.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 巴蒂纳战役又称巴蒂纳行动，是二战期间斯雷姆战线上的一场战斗。1944年11月11日至29日，苏联红军和南斯拉夫游击队与德国国防军及其盟军在巴兰尼亚巴蒂纳村附近交战，战场位于多瑙河右岸。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的战斗结束日期。

en.s: The My Trach Massacre (Vietnamese: Thảm sát Mỹ Trạch') was a massacre of Vietnamese civilians carried out by the French army during French rule in Vietnam. The massacre occurred in Mỹ Trạch village, Mỹ Thủy commune, Lệ Thủy District, Quảng Bình Province, Vietnam from 12 pm to 2 am on 29 November 1947. In this operation, 326 houses were burnt. Many women were raped by the French soldiers before being killed. Over 300 civilian residents in Mỹ Trạch were killed, of which 170 were women and were 157 children. Many entire families were killed.
en.n: The local government account dates the My Trach massacre to 29 November 1947.

zh.s: 美澤屠殺是法国统治越南期间，法国军队对越南平民实施的一场屠杀。1947年11月29日中午至次日凌晨2时，越南广平省丽水县美水社美泽村发生屠杀。法军在行动中烧毁326间房屋，并在杀害多名妇女前对她们实施强奸。300多名村民遇害，其中170名是妇女，157名是儿童，许多家庭全家遇害。
zh.n: 当地政府记录将美泽屠杀日期定为1947年11月29日。

en.t: The Pingjin campaign begins in northern China
en.s: The Pingjin campaign began on November 29, 1948, as Communist forces moved against Nationalist positions across the Beiping–Tianjin–Zhangjiakou area of northern China. It was one of the three major campaigns in the final stage of the Chinese Civil War and continued until January 31, 1949.
en.n: November 29 marks the start of the campaign, not its conclusion in January 1949.

zh.t: 平津战役在中国北方打响
zh.s: 1948年11月29日，平津战役开始。解放军在北平、天津、张家口一带与国民党军展开作战。这是国共内战后期的三大战役之一，战事一直持续到1949年1月31日。
zh.n: 11月29日是战役开始的日期，战役于次年1月结束。

en.s: Thailand's Silent Coup of November 29, 1951, otherwise known as the Radio Coup, consolidated the military's hold on the country. It reinstated the 1932 constitution, which effectively eliminated the Senate, established a unicameral legislature composed equally of elected and government-appointed members, and allowed serving military officers to supplement their commands with important ministerial portfolios.

zh.s: 1951年11月29日，泰国发生“静默政变”，又称“电台政变”，军方借此巩固了对国家的控制。政变恢复了1932年宪法，实际上取消了参议院，建立由选举产生和政府任命成员各占一半的一院制立法机构，并允许现役军官在原有职务之外兼任重要部长职位。

en.s: The 1951 Syrian coup d'état (Arabic: انقلاب 1951 في سوريا) was the fourth coup d'état in Syria following independence. The coup was led by Adib Shishakli, who forced the existing government, led by President Hashim al-Atassi and Prime Minister Maarouf al-Dawalibi to resign.

zh.s: 1951年叙利亚政变是叙利亚独立后的第四次政变。阿迪卜·希沙克利领导政变，迫使总统哈希姆·阿塔西和总理马鲁夫·达瓦利比领导的政府辞职。

en.s: A by-election was held for the Australian House of Representatives seat of Werriwa on 29 November 1952. This was triggered by the death of Labor Party MP Bert Lazzarini. The by-election was won by Labor Party candidate Gough Whitlam.

zh.s: 1952年11月29日，澳大利亚众议院韦里瓦选区举行补选。工党议员伯特·拉扎里尼去世后，该席位空出。工党候选人高夫·惠特拉姆赢得补选。

en.t: President-elect Eisenhower begins his trip to Korea
en.s: On November 29, 1952, US president-elect Dwight D. Eisenhower set out from New York on a secret trip to see the Korean War for himself. He had promised during the election campaign that he would visit Korea if elected. His party reached Seoul on December 2, where he met commanders and troops over the following days. November 29 marks the start of the journey in the United States, not his arrival in Korea.
en.n: The trip began in New York on November 29; Eisenhower arrived in Seoul on December 2.

zh.t: 美国当选总统艾森豪威尔启程前往朝鲜半岛
zh.s: 1952年11月29日，美国当选总统德怀特·艾森豪威尔从纽约秘密启程，前往朝鲜半岛实地了解朝鲜战争。他曾在竞选时承诺，若当选就会赴韩。随行人员于12月2日抵达首尔，此后数日他会见了指挥官和士兵。11月29日记录的是他在美国出发，而不是到达韩国。
zh.n: 行程于11月29日从纽约开始；艾森豪威尔12月2日才到达首尔。

en.s: The 1953 Cupa României final was the 16th final of Romania's most prestigious football cup competition. It was disputed between CCA București and Flamura Roşie Arad, and was won by Flamura Roşie Arad after a game with 1 goal, in extra time. It was the second cup for Flamura Roşie Arad after the one from 1947–48 season.

zh.s: 1953年罗马尼亚杯决赛是该项赛事的第16场决赛，由布加勒斯特陆军体育俱乐部对阵阿拉德红旗队。阿拉德红旗队在加时赛中以一球取胜，这是球队继1947–48赛季后第二次夺得杯赛冠军。

en.s: A by-election was held in the Barbadian constituency of St Lucy on 29 November 1954.

zh.s: 1954年11月29日，巴巴多斯圣露西选区举行补选。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 29 November 1960. They were won by the governing Antigua Labour Party (ALP), whose leader Vere Bird was re-elected as Chief Minister, a position he had held since 1 January 1960 when the position was created. The 1960 elections were the only general elections held in the territory during its membership of the West Indies Federation, a brief attempt to create a federal state in the British West Indies.

zh.s: 1960年11月29日，安提瓜和巴布达举行大选。执政的安提瓜工党获胜，党魁维尔·伯德再次当选首席部长；该职位于1960年1月1日设立，他从设立之日起担任此职。这是安提瓜和巴布达成为西印度群岛联邦成员期间举行的唯一一次大选。西印度群岛联邦曾短暂尝试在英属西印度群岛建立联邦国家。

en.t: Enos, a chimpanzee, is launched into space. The spacecraft orbits the Earth twice and splashes down off the coast of Puerto Rico
en.s: Enos (c. 1957 – November 4, 1962) was a chimpanzee launched into space by NASA on November 29, 1961, following his predecessor Ham. He was the only chimpanzee to orbit the Earth and the third hominid to do so after cosmonauts Yuri Gagarin and Gherman Titov. Enos was brought from the Miami Rare Bird Farm on April 3, 1960.

zh.t: 黑猩猩埃诺斯进入太空
zh.s: 埃诺斯（约生于1957年，1962年11月4日去世）是NASA送入太空的黑猩猩。1961年11月29日，埃诺斯搭乘航天器进入太空，绕地球飞行两圈后在波多黎各附近溅落。他是继汉姆之后第二只进入太空的黑猩猩，也是继宇航员尤里·加加林和格尔曼·季托夫之后第三位进入太空的人类近亲。1960年4月3日，埃诺斯从迈阿密珍禽农场被带走。

en.s: Trans-Canada Air Lines (TCA) Flight 831 was a scheduled Canadian flight from Montréal–Dorval International Airport to Toronto International Airport on November 29, 1963. About five minutes after takeoff in poor weather, the Douglas DC-8-54CF Jet Trader operating the flight crashed about 32 km (20 mi) north of Montreal, near Ste-Thérèse-de-Blainville, Quebec, Canada, killing all 111 passengers and seven crew members.

zh.t: 加拿大跨大陆航空831号班机
zh.s: 加拿大跨大陆航空831号班机是从蒙特利尔多瓦尔国际机场飞往多伦多国际机场的定期航班。1963年11月29日，飞机在恶劣天气中起飞约5分钟后，在距蒙特利尔约32公里处、魁北克圣泰雷兹-德布兰维尔附近坠毁。机上111名乘客和7名机组人员全部遇难。执飞的是道格拉斯DC-8-54CF客机。

en.t: President Lyndon B. Johnson establishes the Warren Commission
en.s: On November 29, 1963, U.S. President Lyndon B. Johnson established the Warren Commission through Executive Order 11130. The commission was appointed to investigate President John F. Kennedy's assassination in Dallas a week earlier, as well as the subsequent killing of the alleged assassin, and to report its findings to Johnson.
en.n: This records the commission's establishment by executive order, not its later congressional authorization or report.

zh.t: 约翰逊总统成立沃伦委员会
zh.s: 1963年11月29日，美国总统林登·约翰逊签署第11130号行政令，成立沃伦委员会。委员会负责调查一周前肯尼迪总统在达拉斯遇刺案，以及嫌疑人随后被杀一事，并向约翰逊提交调查结论。
zh.n: 此条记录委员会依行政令成立的日期；国会授权和调查报告均在之后。

en.s: General elections were held in Antigua and Barbuda on 29 November 1965, and continued on 15 December after three candidates withdrew before the original date. They were won by the governing Antigua Labour Party (ALP), whose leader Vere Bird was re-elected as Chief Minister. Six ALP candidates ran unopposed, meaning the party had won the elections before a vote was cast. Voter turnout was 42.8%.

zh.s: 安提瓜和巴布达于1965年11月29日举行大选，并于12月15日继续投票，因为有3名候选人在原定日期前退出。执政的安提瓜工党获胜，党魁维尔·伯德再次当选首席部长。该党有6名候选人自动当选，无须投票。投票率为42.8%。

en.t: President Johnson announces Robert McNamara's planned departure from the Pentagon
en.s: On November 29, 1967, President Lyndon B. Johnson announced that Robert McNamara would leave his post as US secretary of defense at a later date and that he would be nominated to lead the World Bank. Johnson said no exact departure date had been set. McNamara remained in office until February 29, 1968.
en.n: November 29 was the announcement, not McNamara's final day as defense secretary in February 1968.

zh.t: 约翰逊总统宣布麦克纳马拉将卸任美国国防部长
zh.s: 1967年11月29日，美国总统林登·约翰逊宣布，国防部长罗伯特·麦克纳马拉将在日后离任，并将获提名出任世界银行行长。约翰逊当时说，离任日期尚未确定。麦克纳马拉直到1968年2月29日才结束国防部长任期。
zh.n: 11月29日是宣布未来离任的日期；麦克纳马拉实际卸任是在1968年2月。

en.s: Operation Hiroshima was a military operation conducted during the Biafran War by the Biafran 4th Commando Brigade in an attempt to recapture Onitsha from the Nigerian 2nd Division. The operation ultimately resulted in failure and ended in the deaths of numerous local and foreign mercenaries and Biafran soldiers.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 比夫拉内战期间，比夫拉第4突击队旅发动广岛行动，试图从尼日利亚第2师手中夺回奥尼查。行动最终失败，许多当地和外国雇佣兵以及比夫拉士兵丧生。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The 1969 New Zealand general election was a nationwide vote to determine the shape of Parliament's 36th term. It saw the Second National Government headed by Prime Minister Keith Holyoake of the National Party win a fourth consecutive term. This is the most recent election where an incumbent government won a fourth term in office.

zh.s: 1969年新西兰大选选出了第36届议会。基思·霍利约克领导的第二届国家党政府连续第四次胜选；这是新西兰在任政府最后一次连续赢得第四届任期。

en.s: The Taiyo Department Store fire was a fire at the Taiyo Department Store, a department store in Kumamoto City, Kumamoto Prefecture, Japan. The fire started at 1:15 p.m. on November 29, 1973; 104 people died. After the fire, regulations pertaining to the construction of buildings were strengthened, one of which mandated external stairs on highrise buildings. The Taiyo Department Store had a basement floor and nine stories.

zh.s: 1973年11月29日下午1时15分，日本熊本县熊本市的太阳百货公司发生火灾，造成104人死亡。火灾后，日本加强了建筑法规，其中一项规定要求高层建筑设置室外楼梯。太阳百货公司有地下1层和地上9层。

en.s: The 1975 New Zealand general election was held on 29 November to elect MPs to the 38th session of the New Zealand Parliament. It was the first general election in New Zealand where 18- to 20-year-olds and all permanent residents of New Zealand were eligible to vote, although only citizens were able to be elected.

zh.s: 1975年11月29日，新西兰举行大选，选出第38届议会成员。这是新西兰首次允许18至20岁居民和所有永久居民投票；只有新西兰公民可以参选。

en.s: Kowloon station (Chinese: 九龍車站), colloquially Old Tsim Sha Tsui Terminal, located in Tsim Sha Tsui on the present site of the Hong Kong Cultural Centre, was the former southern terminus of the Kowloon–Canton Railway (KCR).

zh.s: 九龙车站（中文：九龍車站），俗称旧尖沙咀总站，位于尖沙咀，即现今香港文化中心所在地。这里曾是九广铁路（KCR）的南端总站。

en.s: Elections were held in the Australian state of Queensland on 29 November 1980 to elect the 82 members of the state's Legislative Assembly. The election resulted in a fifth consecutive victory for the National-Liberal Coalition under Joh Bjelke-Petersen. It was the ninth victory of the National Party in Queensland since it first came to office in 1957.

zh.s: 1980年11月29日，澳大利亚昆士兰州举行选举，选出州立法议会82名议员。约翰·比耶尔克-彼得森领导的国家党—自由党联盟连续第五次获胜。这是国家党自1957年首次执政以来，在昆士兰州取得的第九次胜利。

en.s: General elections were held in Honduras on November 29, 1981. Each voter had a single vote to cast for a presidential candidate, with seats in the National Congress divided based on the share of the vote their presidential candidate had won. The result was a victory for Roberto Suazo Cordova and the Liberal Party. Voter turnout was 78.5%.

zh.s: 1981年11月29日，洪都拉斯举行大选。每位选民投票支持一名总统候选人，国民议会席位则按照该总统候选人的得票比例分配。罗伯托·苏亚索·科尔多瓦和自由党获胜，投票率为78.5%。

en.t: Michael Jackson's Thriller album is released
en.s: Michael Jackson's sixth studio album, Thriller, was released through Epic Records on November 29, 1982. Produced by Quincy Jones and Jackson, it included songs such as Billie Jean, Beat It, and Thriller. The album went on to become the best-selling album of all time.
en.n: November 29 is the album's release date; no single release location is established.

zh.t: 迈克尔·杰克逊的专辑《Thriller》发行
zh.s: 1982年11月29日，迈克尔·杰克逊的第六张录音室专辑《Thriller》由史诗唱片发行。制作人是昆西·琼斯和杰克逊本人，收录了《Billie Jean》《Beat It》和《Thriller》等歌曲。此后，它成为史上销量最高的专辑。
zh.n: 11月29日是专辑发行日；目前没有确认一个能代表发行地点的国家。

en.t: 1984 New Zealand National Party leadership election
en.s: The 1984 New Zealand National Party leadership election was held to determine the future leadership of the New Zealand National Party. The election was won by former deputy prime minister Jim McLay.

en.t: The Surinamese military attacks the village of Moiwana during the Suriname Guerrilla War, killing at least 39 civilians, mostly women and children
en.s: After the creation of the Statute of the Kingdom of the Netherlands, the Royal Netherlands Army was entrusted with the defence of Suriname, while the defence of the Netherlands Antilles was the responsibility of the Royal Netherlands Navy. The army set up a separate Netherlands Armed Forces in Suriname (Dutch: Troepenmacht in Suriname, TRIS). zh.s: 《荷兰王国宪章》制定后，荷兰皇家陆军负责苏里南的防务，荷兰皇家海军则负责荷属安的列斯群岛的防务。陆军在苏里南另设一支荷兰武装部队，名为“苏里南驻军”（荷兰语：Troepenmacht in Suriname，TRIS）。1975年苏里南独立后，这支部队改名为苏里南武装部队（Surinaamse Krijgsmacht，SKM）。

en.s: General elections were held in Turkey on 29 November 1987. Prior to the elections, the military junta's restrictions on former politicians were lifted, allowing them to re-enter politics. However, only three political parties were approved by the junta to participate in the election. Despite a reduction in its share of the vote, the Motherland Party retained its majority in parliament, gaining 81 seats.

en.t: North Korean agents plant a bomb on Korean Air Flight 858, which kills all 115 passengers and crew
en.s: Korean Air Flight 858 was a scheduled international passenger flight between Baghdad, Iraq, and Seoul, South Korea. On 29 November 1987, the Boeing 707 flying the route exploded in mid-air upon the detonation of a bomb planted inside an overhead storage bin in the airplane's passenger cabin by two North Korean agents.

zh.t: 朝鲜特工在大韩航空858号班机上安放炸弹，机上115人全部遇难
zh.s: 大韩航空858号班机是往返伊拉克巴格达和韩国首尔的定期国际客运航班。1987年11月29日，两名朝鲜特工在客舱行李架内安放炸弹，炸弹爆炸后，波音707客机在空中解体。机上115名乘客和机组人员全部遇难。

en.s: The Paisley South by-election, 1990 was a parliamentary by-election held on 29 November 1990 for the British House of Commons constituency of Paisley South, in the town of Paisley, Scotland. It was caused by the death of the constituency's Labour Member of Parliament (MP) Norman Buchan. As in the by-election in the neighbouring seat of Paisley North held on the same day, the SNP saw a healthy increase in their share of the vote, but not enough to win, and the Labour Party retained the seat, with Gordon McMaster being their successful candidate.

zh.s: 1990年11月29日，英国下议院苏格兰佩斯利镇佩斯利南选区举行补选。工党议员诺曼·布肯去世后，该席位空出。与同日举行的邻近佩斯利北选区补选一样，苏格兰民族党得票率明显上升，但未能胜出；工党保住席位，由戈登·麦克马斯特当选。

en.s: The Paisley North by-election, 1990 was a parliamentary by-election held on 29 November 1990 for the British House of Commons constituency of Paisley North, in the town of Paisley, Scotland. It was caused by the death of the sitting Member of Parliament for the constituency, Allen Adams. The Scottish National Party (SNP) saw a healthy increase in their share of the vote, but not enough to win, and the Labour Party retained the seat, with Adams' widow Irene being their successful candidate.

en.s: Early parliamentary elections were held in Egypt on 29 November 1990, with a second round for 261 seats on 6 December. They followed a referendum in October on the early dissolution of Parliament due to issues surrounding the legality of the 1987 elections. However, the elections were boycotted by the Socialist Labour Party (SLP), the Liberal Socialists Party (LSP), the Muslim Brotherhood and the New Wafd Party, which claimed that the reformed Electoral Law would fail to ensure free elections.

zh.s: 1990年11月29日，埃及提前举行议会选举，261个席位于12月6日进行第二轮投票。此前，埃及于10月就提前解散议会举行公投，原因是1987年选举的合法性存在问题。社会主义工党、自由社会主义者党、穆斯林兄弟会和新华夫脱党抵制选举，称修订后的选举法无法保障公平选举。

en.s: General elections were held in Saint Kitts and Nevis on 29 November 1993. No party won a majority, and although the Saint Kitts and Nevis Labour Party received the most votes, the People's Action Movement remained in power. Voter turnout was 64.4%.

en.s: A leadership election for the Civic Democratic Party (ODS) was held on 29 November in Kopřivnice, Czech Republic. Václav Klaus was reelected as the party's leader. en.s: The Yokozuna Benefit Memorial Show was a professional wrestling event produced by World Xtreme Wrestling (WXW) promotion which took place on 29 November 2001, at the Lehigh Valley Sports Zone (WXW Arena) in Allentown, Pennsylvania. en.s: The Manila Peninsula siege occurred on November 29, 2007 at The Peninsula Manila hotel in Makati, Philippines. Senator Antonio Trillanes IV, Brigadier General Danilo Lim, and 25 other Magdalo (mutineers) officers walked out of their trial and marched through the streets of Makati. The mutineers called for the ousting of President Gloria Macapagal-Arroyo, and seized the Rizal function room on the second floor of the Manila Peninsula Hotel along Ayala Avenue. Former Vice-President Teofisto Guingona, Jr. as well as some of the soldiers from the Armed Forces of the Philippines joined the march to the hotel.

zh.s: 2007年11月29日，菲律宾马卡蒂市马尼拉半岛酒店发生围困事件。参议员安东尼奥·特里利亚内斯四世、准将达尼洛·林和另外25名马格达洛兵变军官离开庭审现场，穿过马卡蒂街道游行。他们要求总统格洛丽亚·马卡帕加尔-阿罗约下台，并占据马尼拉半岛酒店二楼的黎刹厅。前副总统特奥菲斯托·金戈纳及部分武装部队士兵也加入游行前往酒店。

en.s: The Honduran general election, 2009 was held in Honduras on November 29, 2009, including presidential, parliamentary and local elections. Voters went to the polls to elect: * A new President of Honduras to serve a four-year term starting January 27, 2010. * 128 members to serve a four-year term in the National Congress. * Representatives in municipal (local) governments. en.s: A presidential election was held in Equatorial Guinea on November 29, 2009. Teodoro Obiang Nguema, who has been President of Equatorial Guinea since 1979, ran for another term and won re-election with 95.4% of the vote, according to official results. Opposition leader Plácido Micó Abogo placed second with 3.6%. However, international observers and the main opposition candidate questioned the legitimacy of this election, noting the poor management which created an unfriendly field for other candidates to take part, media manipulation and the unbalanced results.

en.s: General elections for President and Parliament took place in Uruguay on 25 October and 29 November 2009. In parliamentary election results, the Broad Front (left-wing coalition) emerged the winner, electing 16 senators and 50 deputies, while the National Party elected 9 senators and 30 deputies, the Colorado Party 5 Senators and 17 Deputies, and the Independent Party 2 deputies. In the presidential contest, the first round of voting produced no majority winner, with José Mujica of the incumbent Broad Front receiving 48% of the vote and Luis Alberto Lacalle of the National Party 29%. In the runoff, Mujica handily defeated Lacalle to win the presidency.

zh.s: 2009年10月25日和11月29日，乌拉圭举行总统和议会选举。议会选举中，左翼联盟广泛阵线获胜，赢得16个参议院席位和50个众议院席位；民族党获9个参议院席位和30个众议院席位；红党获5个参议院席位和17个众议院席位；独立党获2个众议院席位。总统选举首轮无人获得多数，执政广泛阵线候选人何塞·穆希卡获得48%，民族党候选人路易斯·阿尔贝托·拉卡列获29%。在决选中，穆希卡大胜拉卡列，当选总统。

en.s: The 2009 New Democracy leadership election was held on 29 November 2009, following the official announcement of the resignation of Kostas Karamanlis, after more than 12 years (since 21 March 1997) as leader of New Democracy, the main centre-right political party and one of the two major parties in Greece (at that time, the other of the two major parties was PASOK, the social democratic and center-left political party). Karamanlis announced that he would start procedures for the election of a new president on 4 October 2009, after the defeat of majority party New Democracy in the 2009 Greek legislative election, which was held in the same day.

zh.s: 2009年11月29日，新民主党举行领导人选举。此前，党魁科斯塔斯·卡拉曼利斯于10月4日宣布，在新民主党于当日举行的2009年希腊议会选举中败选后，将启动选出新主席的程序；他自1997年3月21日起担任党魁，已超过12年。新民主党是希腊主要中右翼政党，也是当时两大政党之一，另一党为中左翼社会民主党泛希腊社会主义运动（PASOK）。

en.s: On November 29, 2009, four American police officers of Lakewood, Washington, were fatally shot at the Forza (now Blue Steele) coffee shop, located at 11401 Steele Street #108 South in the Parkland unincorporated area of Pierce County, Washington, near Tacoma. en.s: LAM Mozambique Airlines Flight 470 (TM470/LAM470) was a scheduled international passenger flight from Maputo International Airport, Mozambique that crashed on 29 November 2013 into the Bwabwata National Park in Namibia en route to Quatro de Fevereiro Airport, Angola. The aircraft operating the flight, an Embraer 190, departed Maputo at 11:26 CAT (09:26 UTC) and was due to land at 14:10 WAT (13:10 UTC), but failed to arrive at its destination.

en.s: The Taiwan local elections of 2014, commonly known as the nine-in-one elections (Chinese: 九合一選舉), were held on Saturday, 29 November 2014, to elect the Municipal Mayors, Municipal Councilors, Chiefs of indigenous districts in municipalities, Councilors of indigenous districts in municipalities, County Magistrates (City Mayors), County (City) Councilors, Township Chiefs, Township Councilors and chiefs of village (borough) in 6 municipalities and 16 counties (cities). Elected officials would serve a four-year term. Polling stations were open from 8 am to 4pm on the election day. The elections resulted in a substantial defeat for the KMT.

zh.s: 2014年台湾地方选举又称“九合一选举”，于11月29日星期六举行，选出6个直辖市和16个县市的市长、议员、原住民区区长和议员、县市长、县市议员、乡镇市长和议员，以及村里长。当选者任期四年。投票站于选举日上午8时至下午4时开放。选举结果显示，国民党遭遇重大挫败。

en.s: The 2014 Victorian state election, held on Saturday, 29 November 2014, was for the 58th Parliament of Victoria. The incumbent centre-right Coalition minority government, led by Liberal Party leader and Premier Denis Napthine and National Party leader and Deputy Premier Peter Ryan, was defeated by the centre-left Labor Party opposition, led by Daniel Andrews.

Aside from the King, the most powerful institutions in Jordan politics are the coercive apparatus (military, police, intelligence service); the cabinet government which the king appoints; and the public bureaucracy.
